## Case studies

- [AI Job Hunt engine](https://solomonjoshua.com/work/ai-job-hunt/): built to run unattended on a Cloudflare Worker's 5-minute cron. Claude Opus 5.5 vets public job-board posts (fit 1–10, scam risk, pay), writes the best 10, and an adversarial second pass removes any claim not in the CV. Only strong, clean fits send by themselves after a 3-hour hold, enforced by a database CHECK constraint and re-checked before sending; the rest wait for approval. A Google Apps Script Gmail bridge sends from Gmail and brings replies back into the thread. Hard daily dollar budget; 700+ automated tests.
- [AI Video Engine](https://solomonjoshua.com/work/ai-video-engine/): a one-line topic becomes a finished 1080x1920 short with burned captions. Claude writes the script, OpenAI makes images and voice, a custom FFmpeg engine renders. About $1 per video vs about $12 for paid generative video; a real 2-part story cost $0.72. Cost estimate before every paid command; never posts by itself; 406 unit tests and 300 acceptance checks.
- Agency email & SMS platform (Arrow Group Consulting, 2026): built with Claude Code on Cloudflare Workers + D1; 6 accounts live about 5 weeks after the first commit; 3,200+ automated tests; projected ~89% lower monthly platform cost; now replacing GoHighLevel.
